integrity.evidence: A fully specified finite vertex-set exhaustive enumeration, a complete acyclic simplicial Morse matching, an independent mod-two chain check, and a full 336-automorphism signed Lefschetz calculation are reproduced by the included program.
integrity.source_access: Relevant full arXiv articles examined; the Cambridge graph-specific chapter was accessible at abstract and introduction, not full text.

scientific_limitations: The homotopy classification is for exactly the fourteen-vertex co-Heawood graph at two-independence parameter two; no larger-projective-plane extension is asserted.
Absolute irreducibility concerns rational homology and does not assert an equivariant homotopy equivalence or integral module classification.
No claim of exhaustive publication priority or independent mathematical certification is made.
title: The co-Heawood two-independence complex: eight four-spheres and irreducible symmetry
